summary: Flex LNG Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its November 11, 2026 press release on unaudited third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results. No special-situation transaction is the subject: the filing reports vessel operating revenues of $97.4 million, net income of $42.8 million ($0.79 per share), a TCE rate of $78,875 and adjusted EBITDA of $72.1 million. A third-quarter dividend of $0.75 per share was declared, alongside improved terms on the $330 million sale-leaseback for Flex Artemis and Flex Amber and a new $145.5 million Flex Enterprise sale-leaseback. Watch charter market weakness and spot-rate volatility.
